title: Projection Extension
description: STAC Projection Extension for STAC Catalogs, STAC Collections and STAC Items.

assets.$comment: This validates the fields in Item and Collection Assets, but does not require them.

links.$comment: This validates the fields in links.

assetTemplates.$comment: This validates the fields in asset templates.

linkTemplates.$comment: This validates the fields in link templates.

oneOf.$comment: This validates the fields in the Item Properties.
This is the schema for top-level fields, summaries and item assets in STAC Collections.

item_assets.$comment: This validates the fields in item assets.

oneOf.$comment: The fields can't be used at the top-level of STAC Catalogs, only in links.

proj:code.title: Projection code
proj:code.description: Authority and specific code of the data source (e.g., `EPSG:3857`).

proj:wkt2.title: Coordinate Reference System in WKT2 format
proj:wkt2.description: WKT2 string representing the Coordinate Reference System (CRS) that the `proj:geometry` and `proj:bbox` fields represent.

proj:projjson.title: Coordinate Reference System in PROJJSON format
proj:projjson.description: PROJJSON object representing the Coordinate Reference System (CRS) that the `proj:geometry` and `proj:bbox` fields represent.

proj:geometry.title: Footprint
proj:geometry.description: Defines the footprint of this Item.

proj:bbox.title: Extent
proj:bbox.description: Bounding box of the Item in the asset CRS in 2 or 3 dimensions.

proj:centroid.title: Centroid
proj:centroid.description: Coordinates representing the centroid of the Item (in lat/long).

proj:shape.title: Shape
proj:shape.description: Number of pixels in Y and X directions for the default grid.

proj:transform.title: Transform
proj:transform.description: The affine transformation coefficients for the default grid.

summaries.$comment: Summaries allow lists and JSON Schemas for all fields, ranges don't make sense for any of the fields.
